mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_deployment ( point_tmpl_id, device_deploy_id, alarm_code, point_name, n4_address, point_code, data_type, unit, display_precision, all_path, type, conversion_scale, conversion_offset, poll_frequency, address_format, modbus_address, number_of_bits ) VALUES ( #{pointTmplId}, #{deviceDeployId}, #{alarmCode}, #{pointName}, #{n4Address}, #{pointCode}, #{dataType}, #{unit}, #{displayPrecision}, #{allPath}, #{type}, #{conversionScale}, #{conversionOffset}, #{pollFrequency}, #{addressFormat}, #{modbusAddress}, #{numberOfBits} )
